value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether you put down under 20% (insured) or 20% or more (uninsured). As of this week, the lowest I can see in Toronto is about 4.34% for an insured mortgage and about 4.44% for an uninsured one. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%. Rates have been climbing this month, so those lowest numbers can move fast.
